## Song

![](../../assets/playable/inomissing/abilities/uta_song.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

The user sings for a few seconds. Every player still in range at the end is sent to Uta World with the user, their bodies stay asleep where they stood. A hit interrupts the song. Nobody under a silence hears it Up to 16 creatures in range are sent to Uta World too and fight for the user there, the others and bosses only fall asleep. A hit on a sleeping body wakes its player, a hit on the user's body ends the dream for everyone. A silence that falls on a sleeping body wakes its player too A player or creature defeated in the dream wakes up and takes heavy damage, and so does the user. While alone in the dream, the user can use this again to end it

<div class="entry-stats" markdown="1">

| --- | --- |

| Beaten cooldown | 120 s (2400 ticks) |
| Interrupted cooldown | 5 s (100 ticks) |

| Pack multiplier when dealing damage | 5× |

</div>

## Staff

![](../../assets/playable/inomissing/abilities/uta_staff.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

## Tot Musica

![](../../assets/playable/inomissing/abilities/tot_musica.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

In Uta World, the user sings the forbidden song. Tot Musica appears, absorbs the user and attacks everyone in the dream. The user can do nothing more and the voice gauge empties twice as fast If Tot Musica is defeated, the dream ends and the user is defeated with it. It must be used twice in a row to confirm

## Voice

![](../../assets/playable/inomissing/abilities/uta_voice.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Passive*

The user's dream lasts as long as the user's voice. The dream empties the gauge and ends when it is empty, the gauge fills again over time A full voice is a dream of 5 minutes, half that once Tot Musica is called. An empty voice is full again after 100 seconds In the dream the user flies freely, the creatures taken by the song fight for the user there
